name: Breacher's load-bearing vest
description: A heavy padded vest covered in webbing, with a single-point sling and two magnets that hold a breaching shotgun.
notes: Laid flat, front up, open down the middle with two buckles; PALS webbing rows on both front panels. CHECK VOLUME: the reference volume is the vest rolled up, while the model's box is the vest spread flat. It has no pockets; pouches and holsters attach to ten webbing points, three down each front panel: the chest points on the top rows below the shoulders, the belly points on the middle rows and the waist points on the rows by the hem, and two down each cummerbund, the upper and lower side points, which are slower to reach. The magnets lie over the right chest and right waist points. The back panel lies underneath without webbing, so it has no back point. Heavy vest: padded panels, a cummerbund each side with its own webbing and a drag handle. A single-point sling runs over the shoulders and across the chest to a steel snap hook; holding a slung gun has no content field yet. Two steel plates on the right side are the magnets; holding a shotgun on them has no content field yet. The worn look is pending: clothing gets inventory and ground models only until a fitted worn family exists.
